qs.q: An environmental health officer investigates factors that help hookworm infective larvae survive and move on grass in warm, moist soil. Which mechanism enables this movement?
qs.e: Infective L3 larvae use capillary action in moist soil and vegetation to move around. They are vulnerable to direct sunlight, drying, and saltwater.
